Admission to BOOrific Nights with glowing jack-o'-lanterns and three haunted houses (Sept 26 - Nov 1)
blurb: Guests enjoy a day with over 40 rides and attractions including a Texas-sized pumpkin patch, an 8-acre corn maze, a county carnival, and seasonal events like BOOrific Nights with glowing jack-o'-lanterns and haunted houses. Food and treats such as Spooky Shakes and Fall-themed Funnel Cakes are available. The festival runs from September 12th to November 8th with free parking.
